title: One of nation’s poorest counties to receive $6 billion data center
source_used: Northeast Mississippi Daily Journal carrying Mississippi Today
key_facts: A $6 billion data center is planned for Jefferson Davis County, Mississippi.
Developer: Eagle Rock Partners; project name: Big Woods Technology Park.
The developer held an informational meeting on Tuesday to answer residents' concerns.
Construction could begin as early as 2027.
Headlines describe the county as one of the poorest in the US.
quote_evidence: A $6 billion data center is being planned for Jefferson Davis County.
Construction could begin as early as 2027.
why_it_matters_hint: A very large project is planned in one of the country's poorest counties.
